display.name: HTTP + gRPC — Refold
display.description: HTTP percentiles come from the request_response_latency_seconds.quantile Summary sub-metric. gRPC percentiles are NOT rendered — the gRPC metrics are Histograms and SigNoz builder-query cannot express histogram_quantile; add a ClickHouseSQL follow-up if percentiles are needed. gRPC call-rate uses the rate of grpc_server_requests_total (server) and grpc_client_duration_seconds.count (client — histogram counter). Filter/label form on ALL metrics here is underscore (Prom-scraped app metrics, both underscore and dot label aliases exist). Values on latency metrics named _seconds may actually be milliseconds — verify the unit after import.
